name: Okishima:1336 [Update 1]
desc:
OKISHIMA is an immersive, physics-driven open-world samurai RPG.

Choose your path as a Ronin or Shogun, switching freely between both. Raid villages, rob homes, execute fortress heists, hunt bounties, battle Oni, and duel other players.

Experience fluid, momentum-based combat featuring procedural animations, dynamic parries, directional limb slicing, and destructible armor.

Explore a beautifully crafted island with realistic environments, atmospheric effects, and endless opportunities to forge your own path

Developed and Owned by Cowoe and F33NY

llm.loop: pick Ronin or Shogun path -> raid villages, rob homes, heist fortresses, hunt bounties -> fight Oni and duel players with physics combat -> reroll and gear up
llm.objectives: master skill-based samurai combat and carve your path on the island
llm.progression: character rerolls, clans, gear and armor
llm.instructions: choose Ronin or Shogun, raid, heist, hunt bounties, battle Oni, duel players
unique: procedural animation combat with directional limb slicing
llm.thumbnails: stylized ink-and-red samurai illustrations and a painted samurai scene; no gameplay shown
llm.complexity_notes: procedural animation, limb slicing, destructible armor, open-world island, many activities
